about: Known noise the inspector driver does not fail on. Each rule: kind (console-error, console-warning, page-error, request-failed, wrong-route, http-404, http-4xx, *), match (a regex over the one-line text), reason (why it is not a bug). Add a rule only for noise that is present on clean main.

rules.reason: A local dev profile sets no sandbox origin; the app says so on every page load.
The header's star count calls GitHub without a token, and GitHub refuses it with 403 once the per-IP allowance is spent, which a sweep does.
The legacy Evals screen redirects to Evaluate before mounting (LegacyEvalRedirect in components/routing/legacy-eval-redirect.tsx); the surface stays for old links.
ComputerRoute in App.tsx sends the user to Servers while the computers flag is off. Only an explicit false from PostHog redirects, and the driver's guest and dev accounts have it off.
The Sessions route in App.tsx sends the user to Servers while the unified sessions flag is off. Only an explicit false from PostHog redirects, and the driver's guest and dev accounts have it off.

EventsRoute and EventTriggersRoute in App.tsx send the user to Servers while the events flag (useEventsEnabled) is off. Only an explicit false from PostHog redirects, and the driver's guest and dev accounts have it off.
ProjectEnvironmentsRoute sends the user to Servers while the project environments flag is off. Only an explicit false from PostHog redirects, and the driver's guest and dev accounts have it off.
App.tsx sends the Registry tab to the default hub while the registry-enabled flag is not on, which it is not for the driver's accounts.
App.tsx sends the Learning tab to the default hub unless the mcpjam-learning flag is on and the user is signed in; a guest is not.
WebmcpInspectorRoute in App.tsx sends the user to Servers while the WebMCP inspector flag is off. Only an explicit false from PostHog redirects, and the driver's guest and dev accounts have it off.
Tracing is hostedBlocked (shared/app-surfaces.ts) and on a hosted run (dev:hosted) App.tsx sends a hosted-blocked tab to Servers with a toast.
